timeline.summary: Foseco India Limited’s shareholders approved Mr. Henry James Knowles (DIN: 08751453) as Non-Executive Director via remote e-voting on May 10, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹201.88 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹33.81 Cr.
Foseco India Limited shared its investor presentation for an analyst meeting with Mahendra Kumar Dutia (Controller of Accounts & Company Secretary) on May 13, 2026, at 10:00 AM (IST).
Foseco India approved the proposed sale of up to 1.77% stake in subsidiary Foseco Crucible for ₹134.75 Cr to meet public shareholding requirements.
Foseco India Limited posted its investor presentation on June 28, 2026, for analyst/institutional investor meetings on June 29–30, 2026, via its website.
Foseco India Limited approved acquisition of Vesuvius India Limited's Mehsana crucibles business undertaking for ₹43.25 Cr via slump sale, to be completed by 31 December 2026.
Foseco India reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹231.41 Cr and PAT of ₹36.4 Cr, reflecting sequential improvement in operations.

Foseco India Limited’s **Mahendra Kumar Dutia** (Controller of Accounts & Company Secretary) announced analyst/institutional investor meetings from August 18–20, 2026, with presentations available online.
